note: Russia: Belarusians move freely; nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90, 60, 30 or 14 days (most within 90 days a calendar year or a set period, not modelled; China's and Vietnam's 30 days temporary, to 2027), but every visa-exempt visitor must first obtain an electronic travel authorisation with a QR code through the Gosuslugi app (taken as an ETA). Nationals of the e-Visa list (the EU, most of Europe and Asia's partners) apply online for 30 days, entering at the listed crossings; everyone else needs a visa, the United States, Canada, the UK and Australia among them. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' rules.
